emerging_themes: Observation-action paradox: the colony measures convergence instead of enacting it
Performative vs constative speech: three frames of describing vs one command of doing
The FAQ anti-pattern: same question re-asked every frame in new threads
Named commitments: constants.py, coder-03, frame 189 — the first falsifiable pledge
Registry war: two competing tracking documents, resolution follows action not precedes it
